hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per warlock level after 1st

options.description: Leather armor and any simple weapon

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: You have made a pact with an Otherworldly Patron: The Archfey or The Fiend.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Your arcane research and the magic bestowed on you by your patron have given you facility with spells. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You have a number of spell slots equal to your Pact Magic level, but they are all the same level. They recharge on a short or long rest.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: You learn invocations (special magical abilities). You gain 2 at 2nd level, 1 more at 5th, 7th, and 9th level, and another one at 11th, 13th, 15th, 17th, and 19th.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Choose Pact of the Blade (use an action to summon a magical weapon), Pact of the Chain (gain a familiar with extra abilities), or Pact of the Tome (gain a Book of Shadows with three extra cantrips you can cast and additional 1st-level spell slots from recharging them on a short rest).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one score by 2, or two by 1. Max 20.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: You choose one 6th-level spell from the warlock list; you can cast it once per long rest without expending a spell slot. At 13th, 15th, 17th, and 19th level, you learn another (7th, 8th, 9th, 9th respectively).

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: You can spend 1 minute entreating your patron for aid to regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots. Once used, can't use again for 1d4 long rests.

subclasses.name: The Archfey
subclasses.description: Your patron is a lord or lady of the fey, a being of tremendous power whose court is the natural world. Your magic reflects this association.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: As an action, charmed or frightened by you within 10 ft makes WIS save or is charmed/frightened 1 turn. Recharges on short rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Reaction when you take damage: teleport up to 60 ft to unoccupied space you can see, become invisible until end of your next turn or until you attack/hard cast.

subclasses.name: The Archfey Patron
subclasses.description_en: Your patron is a powerful fey lord, lady of the mists, or similar. Your magic is whimsical.
subclasses.description_es: Tu patrón es un poderoso señor feérico, dama de las nieblas o similar. Tu magia es caprichosa.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: Action: 10-ft radius Wis save charmed or frightened 1 round.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Reaction when damaged: teleport 60 ft and invisible until your turn.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: Advantage on saves vs being charmed; magic re-targets to caster.

features.name: Soul of the Archfey
features.description: Cast Charm Person and Greater Invisibility at will.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: Action: Wis save; creature sees nothing real; on imagination attacks.

subclasses.name: The Celestial Patron
subclasses.description_en: Your patron is a celestial: an angel, couatl, deva, solars, or similar. Your weapon is light.
subclasses.description_es: Tu patrón es celestial: ángel, couatl, deva, solar o similar. Tu arma es la luz.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Celestial)
features.description: Add Cure Wounds, Revivify, etc.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: Bonus action: spend a slot to heal warlock level + CHA mod to target.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Resistance to radiant damage. Add CHA mod to radiant/fire damage from warlock cantrips and spells.

features.name: Celestial Revelation
features.description: Action: see invisible, fly 10 ft, dim light; use 1/warlock level use per long rest.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: Reaction when reduced to 0 HP: expend slot to gain temp HP and target one creature.

features.name: Summon a Star
features.description: Cast a level 7 spell (Greater Restoration / Wall of Fire, etc.) as bonus action.

subclasses.name: The Fathomless Patron
subclasses.description_en: Your patron is Dagon, an aquatic horror, or other deep-sea entity. Your magic is the darkness of the sea.
subclasses.description_es: Tu patrón es Dagon, horror acuático u otra entidad abisal. Tu magia es la oscuridad del mar.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Fathomless)
features.description: Thunderwave, Lightning Bolt, etc.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deep
features.description: Bonus action create water tentacle: 1d8+CHA bludgeoning or 10 ft pull.

features.name: Guardians of the Deep
features.description: Sea creatures ignore you; advantage on stealth near water.

features.name: Grasping Tail
features.description: Create tentacles attack with CHA mod (1d6+CHA).

features.name: Fathomless Soul
features.description: Cast Cone of Cold (5/turn) or Lightning Bolt 2x per turn (free).

subclasses.name: The Fiend
subclasses.description: You have made a pact with a Fiend, a powerful otherworldly being of malice and cunning. Such a being might be a powerful lord of the Nine Hells, a duke or baron of Gehenna, or a powerful elemental prince of the Abyss.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing (Optional)
features.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, gain temporary HP equal to your CHA mod + warlock level.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: As a bonus action, you can add a d10 to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw you make. You must finish a short or long rest before using this again.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Choose one damage type at the end of each short/long rest. You have resistance to that damage type until you choose differently.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature with an attack and deal damage, you can hurl it through the lower planes. The target takes 10d10 psychic damage (CON save half). It reappears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 ft of you.

subclasses.name: The Hexblade Patron
subclasses.description_en: Your patron is a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell. Your bond is forged with a sentient weapon.
subclasses.description_es: Tu patrón es una entidad misteriosa del Páramo Sombrío. Tu vínculo se forja con un arma sensible.

features.name: Hex Magic
features.description: Expanded spell list: Shield, Bless, Lightning Bolt, etc.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: Bonus action target a creature; deal 1d6 + Proficiency bonus extra damage; score crits on 19-20.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: Spawn specter from a corpse (using a spell slot) acts on turn.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: Reaction when hit by attack: roll d6: 4+ spell failure.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.description: Hexblade's Curse target = 2 creatures; restore on short rest.

subclasses.name: The Undead Patron
subclasses.description_en: Your patron is Vecna, a lich, or other powerful undead. Your magic is cold and fearsome.
subclasses.description_es: Tu patrón es Vecna, un liche u otro poderoso no-muerto. Tu magia es fría y terrible.

features.name: Expanded Spell List (Undead)
features.description: False Life, Blindness/Deafness, etc.

features.name: Form of the Dead
features.description: Advantage on death saves; you don't need to sleep; immune to sleep/disease; speak with dead.

features.name: Grave Managed
features.description: Bonus action: create skeletal form and ward zone.

features.name: Spirit Projection
features.description: Project your spirit; immune to physical; damage projection cast.

features.name: Undying Servitude
features.description: Cast Animate Dead and Create Undead at will.
